dishes.name: Socca
dishes.desc: A thin chickpea flour pancake cooked in a wood oven and eaten hot with black pepper. Nice's classic street food.

dishes.name: Pissaladière
dishes.desc: Bread dough topped with slow-cooked onions, anchovies and black olives, but no cheese or tomato. Found in every Nice bakery.

dishes.name: Pan bagnat
dishes.desc: A round roll filled with tuna, tomatoes, eggs, olives and olive oil. The Niçois beach lunch.

dishes.name: Salade niçoise
dishes.desc: A salad of tomato, tuna, anchovy, olives, egg and raw vegetables, dressed with olive oil, from Nice.

dishes.name: Tourte de blettes
dishes.desc: A sweet or savoury tart filled with Swiss chard, pine nuts and raisins. A traditional dessert of Nice bakeries and markets.

dishes.name: Petits farcis niçois
dishes.desc: Courgettes, tomatoes, peppers and onions stuffed with minced meat and baked. A Niçois home dish found in traditional restaurants.
